capabilities: Post short journal entries into daily notes via a timeline editor
Browse entries in a chronological social-style feed with rich formatting
Tag posts with autocomplete and per-tag color rules
Attach clipboard or dragged images and paste URLs as OGP link cards
Pin notes to the top of the feed, with optional scheduled pinning
disambiguation: Not a social media client; the 'feed' is a private timeline of local journal entries stored in your vault.
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.14.4 or newer; Windows, Linux, and Android are listed as untested. Stores entries as ```wr code blocks inside daily note files rather than separate notes. Supports 11 languages across 12 locales. Link previews send a web request to the target URL; otherwise everything runs locally.
intentEvidence: Wrot relies on Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin, so make sure it is turned on.
problem: Daily notes give no quick, low-friction capture interface for fleeting thoughts and short updates as they happen during the day.

summary: Micro-journaling plugin that adds a social-feed style timeline for posting short entries into your daily notes as wr code blocks.
